story: NFR Workspace: from firefighting to prepared judgement

screens.title: From firefighting to prepared judgement.
screens.subtitle: Scale from everyday AI assistance to connected role applications, governed ad hoc agents and controlled process automation.
screens.question: What will this conversation show me?

screens.title: Most banks already have AI assistance.
screens.subtitle: Email, chat, documents, search and meetings are faster, but they mostly help one person with one activity.
screens.closingLine: The next step: from individual assistance to controlled operational work.
screens.question: Do we not have AI already?

screens.title: NFR specialists still absorb the integration burden.
screens.subtitle: Useful AI tools do not automatically create an end-to-end working process.
screens.closingLine: The gap is not intelligence. The person is still the integration layer.
screens.question: So what is still hard?

screens.title: One Workspace. Four ways to get work done.
screens.subtitle: Ask, use, run and create, with the same identity, permissions, evidence and control record.
screens.closingLine: Not every need is a chat. Pick the path that fits the work.
screens.question: What is NFR Workspace?

screens.title: Scaling requires three layers to move together.
screens.subtitle: Work and roles, process and controls, data and platform improve in parallel, not one after another.
screens.closingLine: A better interface alone is not transformation.
screens.question: What has to change to scale it?

screens.title: Role, permissions and controls load before the assistant.
screens.subtitle: Synthetic demonstration: entering the working day of an NFR risk manager.
screens.closingLine: Work, case and controls exist before the chat opens.
screens.question: What does the working day look like?

screens.title: Start with the next decision, not a blank chat.
screens.subtitle: One decision now, then next and watched items. Each says why it is here, what changed and what was prepared.
screens.closingLine: Chat is available, but it is not the organising principle.
screens.question: Where does the day start?

screens.title: For standard work, the case arrives prepared end to end.
screens.subtitle: One periodic third-party review: the role app prepares, a bounded automation routes, the professional decides.
screens.closingLine: AI and automation prepare and route. The professional makes the material judgement.
screens.question: How does standard work run end to end?

screens.title: For the long tail, create a controlled ad hoc agent.
screens.subtitle: Describe the outcome. See the sources, steps and limits before it runs, inside your own permissions.
screens.closingLine: Ad hoc work stays possible. Sources, permissions, actions and review stay visible.
screens.question: What about work no app covers?

screens.title: AI prepares. Professionals decide. Systems record.
screens.subtitle: Each capability has a default authority. None of them owns the risk.
screens.question: What does AI do, and what stays human?

screens.title: Six months to prove one loop on reusable foundations.
screens.subtitle: Work and roles, process and controls, data and platform move through three phases together.
screens.closingLine: Month six proves one complete NFR operating loop, not a collection of AI features.
screens.question: What is the first six-month proof?

screens.title: Value grows as assistance becomes operational work.
screens.subtitle: Risk outcomes, operating performance and capacity are measured separately. Then we choose the first loop.
screens.closingLine: Start with one role, one bounded decision journey and one measurable loop.
screens.question: What is the value, and where do we start?

screens.title: Count hours returned, not model calls.
screens.subtitle: Measured on the worked example: effort, cycle time, quality, control and run cost of one review.
screens.closingLine: Task automation is not the same as role automation.
screens.question: What is the value and when does it pay back?

screens.title: The running prototype, on a synthetic bank.
screens.subtitle: Captures from the working prototype: a risk manager's day, and a read-only agent described in one sentence.
screens.closingLine: Development build: the captures still show the prototype's working title.
screens.question: Does this exist beyond the slides?
